item.title: Precision Workholding Solutions for Modern Machining
item.description:
Precision Workholding Solutions for Modern Machining
#

AUTOGRIP® is recognized as a leading manufacturer of collet chucks in Taiwan, offering solutions engineered for superior clamping force and higher operational speeds compared to conventional collet chucks. The unique mechanism operates by moving the inner collet bushing, altering the taper and actuating the inner elastic collet to securely clamp the workpiece. This design results in a compact profile, minimizing tool interference and making these chucks ideal for small work holding or automatic bar feeding from the rear.

item.title: Precision Flow Control Solutions for Machining Centers
item.description:
Precision Flow Control Solutions for Machining Centers
#

Efficient management of gas or liquid across multiple workstations is essential for maintaining accuracy and productivity in machining operations. AUTOGRIP® offers rotary valves engineered to meet these demands, enabling precise control over the tightening and loosening of clamps at each workstation, all based on the rotation angle. This approach supports optimal machining accuracy and process efficiency.

item.title: Precision Workholding Solutions for Machining Centers
item.description:
Reliable Workpiece Holding for Enhanced Machining Accuracy
#

AUTOGRIP®’s stationary chucks are essential components in machining and industrial environments, designed to securely hold and grip workpieces during various operations. These chucks feature jaws that can be adjusted to tightly grip or release a workpiece, ensuring stability and precision throughout the machining process. Typically mounted on lathes or other machine tools, stationary chucks play a vital role in maintaining the correct position and orientation of workpieces, which is crucial for achieving consistent and accurate results.

item.title: Precision Workholding Solutions for Demanding Machining Tasks
item.description:
Precision Workholding Solutions for Demanding Machining Tasks
#

AUTOGRIP®’s synchronous clamps are purpose-built for high-precision machining environments where maintaining tight tolerances and dimensional accuracy is critical. These clamps feature a design with two or more clamping units connected via a mechanical linkage, ensuring that all units move in perfect synchronization when actuated.
